trial: Moonwell Bastion - image reference to playable battle
platform_validated: macOS, headless import/export plus hidden in-app Chromium Web renderer

image_workflow.asset_access: identical reference, map, actors, chrome and font for both candidates
image_workflow.source_handling: PNG decoded pixels preserved; ancillary metadata removed; hashes in source-art/ASSETS.json

implementation_conditions.contexts: two fresh independent agents with no previous conversation history
implementation_conditions.model_selection: same inherited coordinator model selection, no override
implementation_conditions.budget: one first-complete implementation pass per condition; own headless syntax/input/geometry fixes permitted; no fixed token/wall-clock limit

primary_scenario.reason: Real initial paused battle avoids unmatched simulation clocks. Native Resume and disabled Next Wave reflect true model state.

visual_review.interpretation: Practical tie under the predeclared <=3 point threshold; small observed clarity differences only.

known_findings: Baseline resume/restart glyphs appear as unresolved boxes.
Baseline bottom-center hint is clipped at viewport edge.
Both compact layouts use small supporting text.
unverified_browser_flows: precise hit edges and drag-out release
harness_corrections: A selected-desktop screenshot initially caught a viewport resize transient. It was recaptured after a fresh fixed-viewport load; no candidate source changed, no score penalty.

limits: One pair does not prove general skill effectiveness or causal quality improvement.
Shared generated artwork reduces art-access differences; the treatment concerns implementation guidance.
Exact backend model identities and generation seeds were not pinned.
No real-device FPS, network deployment, audio or production integration claim.
